name: Alpha Microelectronics Corporation
summary: Alpha Microelectronics Corporation specializes in the full lifecycle of integrated circuits (ICs), from initial research and development to their design, application, and commercialization. Its extensive product portfolio encompasses a range of specialized integrated circuits, including those for speech, multi-channel voice processing, and recording capabilities. The company also offers diverse microcontrollers (MCUs), from general-purpose to specific LCD and 32-bit versions. Beyond core ICs, Alpha Microelectronics provides essential hardware and software development tools, alongside a suite of supporting 'accessory' ICs. These accessories feature components like motor drivers, audio amplifiers, analog-to-digital converters (ADCs) with microphone inputs, and wireless power transfer solutions. These ICs are predominantly integrated into a wide array of consumer electronics, powering devices such as audio equipment, personal electronic gadgets, home appliances, toys, gifts, and various interactive consumer products. Established in 1992, Alpha Microelectronics maintains its corporate headquarters in Hsinchu, Taiwan.
